name: Dead City: Red Protocol
summary:
A once-thriving city has become a dangerous battlefield. Hostile forces control the streets, armed enemies patrol the urban districts, and every mission brings a new threat. When the red protocol is activated, there is only one objective: enter the city, complete your mission, and survive.

Dead City: Red Protocol is a third-person action shooter focused on urban combat, exploration, missions, vehicles, and intense encounters.

Explore a large city environment filled with streets, buildings, traffic, enemy-controlled areas, and hidden locations. Move through the city on foot or take control of different vehicles as you travel between objectives.

Engage enemies using a variety of weapons and combat tactics. Fight through dangerous streets, respond to hostile attacks, complete missions, and navigate an urban environment where danger can appear at any moment.
